title: Psychosomatic Direct (PsyDi) (ger. "Psychosomatik Direkt")
summary:
Within the framework of the research project, the rehapro-model-project "Psychosomatic direct (PsyDi)” (ger. “Psychosomatik Direkt”) is evaluated.
Health service of patients with mental or psychosomatic illnesses is still improvable. Therefore, the rehapro model project of the Deutsche Rentenversicherung Baden-Württemberg (DRV BW) aims to create a low-threshold access for those being affected and their attending physician (general practitioners and licensed psychological psychotherapists). The formal application process is eliminated and the transition from outpatient care to rehabilitation is faster and less complicated. It is also intended to improve communication between referring physicians and the rehabilitation facility.
The main target group of the model project Psychosomatik Direkt are all insured persons of the DRV Baden-Württemberg in the model regions Freiburg, Ravensburg, Stuttgart and Böblingen with depressive disorders (ICD-10: F32 and F33), reaction to severe stress, and adjustment disorders (ICD-10: F43), anxiety disorders (ICD-10: F40 and F41) and somatoform disorders (ICD-10: F45), who need a rehabilitation, fulfill the insurance-legal requirements and are suitable for psychosomatic rehabilitation.
The aim of the study is to evaluate the newly developed direct assignment (checklist and prescription) as a low-threshold access to psychosomatic rehabilitation. It is to be examined whether the new application procedure is designed to be faster and less complicated, whether the time for insured persons until the start of rehabilitation is shortened, and whether other target variables (e.g., health status, occupational (re)integration, and performance) are improved.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Intervention group (direct assignment):
All insured persons of the DRV BW who complete a rehabilitation treatment in the model regions due to a mental illness (ICD-10: F32-33, F40-41, F43, F45) after direct assignment during the observation period.
Control group (standard application procedure):
Insured persons who complete a rehabilitation treatment in a participating rehabilitation facility due to a mental illness (ICD-10: F32-33, F40-41, F43, F45) during the observation period and who have gone through the current application procedure.
Other inclusion criteria (for IG and KG):
- There is no pension application
- There is no pension claim
- There has been no previous psychosomatic rehabilitation due to the current diagnosis
- Age of majority and working age (18-65 years)
Exclusion criteria:
No communication in German possible.
